title: We added Apple out-of-bounds write vulnerability CVE-2026-86950 to the KEV Catalog. Visit https:// go.dhs.gov/Z3Q & apply mitigations to pro

CVE-2026-86950.evidence: CISA added CVE-2026-86950 to the KEV Catalog on Sep 29, confirming observed in-the-wild exploitation; consistent with Apple's 'may have been exploited in targeted attacks' wording.
